text: The India maps (`IndiaMap`, `IndiaBubbleMap`, `IndiaPointMap`) draw the Government of India's own boundaries: Bharat Maps (NIC), simplified from Survey of India 1:50,000 data, replacing a file inherited from the SMILE portal of unknown provenance. The projection is unchanged. Every island is kept — Lakshadweep is drawn as its cluster of islands and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands with all 270 above 0.01 km² — islands too small to see at a minimum mark, and a thin coastline sits beneath the regions so they read on the page (~29 KB gzipped, from 22). `IndiaMap` gains `scale` (`quantile` for a skewed reading), `legend` (`ramp` for a map inside a card), `legendFormat`, and `selected` / `onSelect`, which make every State/UT a button. Chandigarh, Delhi, Puducherry, and Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, too small to see or hit, wear a hollow ring in their own shade that takes the focus and the click, leaving the true boundary visible; Lakshadweep's island cluster is itself the target.
